# Frontier Sector Code
The Frontier Sector Code is enacted by the Trans-Solar Federation to preserve order, safety, and the rule of law in the Frontier. It applies firmly and equally to every person in the Sector. It is not a shield for the guilty, nor a weapon against the innocent. Every person is expected to know the Code and obey it. No office, rank, or affiliation places a person above it.
## Structure
The Code is divided into two parts:
- [textlink="General Part" link="FrontierCodeGeneral"] — jurisdiction, rights, courts, warrants, and offenses. - [textlink="Penal Framework" link="FrontierCodePenal"] — offense grades, contraband tiers, sentencing, and procedure.
The General Part applies to every person in the Frontier Sector. The Penal Framework sets out how offenses are graded and punished.
## OOC Disclaimer
This document is in-character law. It does not replace the server rules. Certain offenses described here—especially sexual harassment, non-consensual sexual conduct, hate speech, and other severe misconduct—are also violations of the server rules and may result in staff punishment, including bans.
[textlink="Click here to read the rules" link="FrontierRuleset"]
Parenthetical notes marked OOC are implementation notes only and are not part of the law. OOC administration always takes precedence over the Frontier Sector Code.
